mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome to this journey—a journey into the unpredictable world that shapes so much more of our lives than we often realize. Have you ever wondered just how much of what we call "success" is really the result of skill, or if maybe—just maybe—luck is quietly steering the wheel? Together, we're about to explore the fascinating ideas behind Fooled by Randomness: The Hidden Role of Chance in Life and in the Markets, brought to us by Nassim Nicholas Taleb. Taleb invites us to peel back the curtain on everyday events, to see how randomness and probability weave through our choices, our achievements, and even our so-called failures. It's easy to fall for the comforting illusion that we've got things under control—that patterns and plans are all that matter. But what if the real story is a little messier... and a whole lot more interesting? As we dive in, we'll meet traders, investors, and people just like us, all wrestling with the hidden hand of chance. We'll see how our minds crave certainty, how we sometimes mistake luck for talent, and why embracing uncertainty might just be the wisest move of all. So, if you're ready to rethink what you know about risk, success, and the stories we tell ourselves, let's take this adventure together. Get comfortable—because what we're about to discover could change the way you see the world, and your place in it.
